title: Continuing efforts to promote accessibility, validity, and value for American Board of Orthodontics certification
html: The American Board of Orthodontics (ABO) prides itself on serving as a global leader in orthodontic board certification and setting the standards of care for excellence in orthodontics and dentofacial orthopedics. Board certification plays a vital role in protecting the public by assuring patients that orthodontists have demonstrated the competence required to provide safe, effective, and high-quality orthodontic care.1 Therefore, continuously updating the ABO board certification process to align with contemporary credentialing standards and ensure its continued relevance for today’s orthodontic specialists is essential.
